rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when you are very sure that something is true.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hang2 ding6 keoi5 gam1 jat6 wui5 lei4

rows.note: Use this when someone feels confident in their own ability or is sure they can handle something.

example.english: I'm confident I can handle this exam.
example.traditional: 我有信心應付到呢次考試。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 seon3 sam1 jing1 fu6 dou2 ni1 ci3 haau2 si3
